name: Mantario Trail
quote: Spanning an incredible 65 km through the Mantario Wilderness Zone in Whiteshell Provincial Park, the Mantario is Manitoba’s ultimate wilderness experience!
why: Multi-day backpacking trail through the Mantario Wilderness Zone; page gives 65 km (linear in practice, but page only says 'spanning').

name: Pine Point Self-guiding Trail
quote: Pine Point Self-guiding Trail, Whiteshell Provincial Park is a 5 km return trail to the scenic Pine Point Rapids.
why: Out-and-back trail to Pine Point Rapids; 5 km is the return distance.

name: McGillivray Falls Self-guiding Trail
quote: You may choose to hike the short loop of 2.8 km, or the longer 4.6-km trail which reaches McGillivray Lake.
why: Self-guiding trail past McGillivray Falls; the short loop is used (a longer 4.6 km option reaches McGillivray Lake).

name: Whiteshell River Self-guiding Trail
quote: The trail is 2.8 km long, with a few steep climbs up and down. Allow two hours to hike the trail.
why: Self-guiding trail; brochure gives 2.8 km but not whether loop or one way. Name is from the brochure title.
